{{Vanilla|Music}}
'''Music''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] consists of vanilla background music, one new background track, and several [[music disc]]s by community musicians.

== Background music ==
The resource pack replaces the sound event <code>music.overworld.forest</code> with the track '''"Abbey"''' by Vee Vaicekauskas, at 40% volume.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/sounds.json}}</ref> Vanilla uses this sound event in the Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Birch Forest and Dark Forest, so "Abbey" replaces the vanilla music in these biomes, which are also where [[Abbey]]s generate. The same track is available as an (unobtainable) music disc.

All other background music is vanilla.

While a player is inside an [[abandoned village]], all music is stopped for them every tick. See [[Abandoned village#The inhabited house]].

== Credits ==
* '''Vee Vaicekauskas''': background music. The credits file names five tracks, "Refuge", "Abbey", "Ruby", "Through Hell" and "Estus", but only "Abbey" is in the resource pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/CREDITS.txt}}</ref>
* '''DeBlezyBestie''': the Malachite, Crete and Elegy of The Abbey discs.
* '''Ciren''': the Golden disc.
* '''Imtlx''': [[Fishing sounds]].
See [[Credits]].

== Unused sounds ==
The resource pack contains a sound event <code>matcha:custom.false_subwoofer_lullaby</code> that no disc or function uses, and an unused file <code>malachiteORG.ogg</code>.
